tools.name: accept_dataset_agreement
tools.description: Accept the Dataset License Agreement for a quoted order on the buyer's behalf. Call ONLY after the buyer explicitly approves the tier, clip count, price, and the full agreement text. Paid tiers move to awaiting_payment; the free evaluation sample goes straight to Stockfilm's manual review.

tools.name: build_rough_cut
tools.description: Auto-assemble a timed sequence of vintage clips into a video timeline based on a description. Returns an ordered list of clips with durations. Great for creating edit lists or storyboards.

tools.name: check_clip_rights
tools.description: Verify a clip is eligible for a given intended use (commercial, editorial, broadcast, etc.) before licensing.

tools.name: create_4k_checkout
tools.description: Create or resume Stripe hosted checkout for a quoted 4K license. Call ONLY after the user explicitly approves the quoted clip, total price, resolution, license scope, territory, term, and terms. Returns a checkout URL and private order token. The user pays securely in Stripe; never collect card deta

tools.name: find_similar_footage
tools.description: Find visually similar vintage clips by providing a clip ID. Returns clips with similar visual content from the Stockfilm archive.

tools.description: Verify a 4K order's payment with Stripe and retrieve the license, receipt, and private master download after payment. Requires the private order token from create_4k_checkout. tools.name: get_clip_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific Stockfilm clip including description, year shot, location, price, resolution, thumbnail URL, and preview URL.

tools.name: get_dataset_agreement
tools.description: Fetch the full text of the Stockfilm Dataset License Agreement with its version and sha256. Show the text to the buyer before accept_dataset_agreement; the sha256 must be sent back on acceptance.

tools.name: get_dataset_order
tools.description: Check a dataset order: payment state, Stockfilm's approval decision, and, once delivered, download.manifest_url for the metadata files, signed license, and per-clip media URLs. Poll no more than every 10 minutes while awaiting approval. Never report delivery until status is delivered.

tools.name: license_clip
tools.description: Get licensing options for a clip without charging the user. The website offers 4K masters for eligible clips; the separate x402 product is 144p. Review availability, exact price, and terms on the clip page before purchase. This tool does not issue a license or process payment.

tools.name: quote_4k_license
tools.description: Quote an eligible, unwatermarked 4K master using the website's direct license pricing. Verifies actual resolution and licensing availability. Ask for the buyer email and desired use, territory, and term. Does not charge the user. Show the complete quote and terms before requesting checkout approval.

tools.name: quote_training_dataset
tools.description: Create a fixed-price dataset quote for a filtered subset and get a private order_token. Freezes the exact clip list. tools.name: scope_training_dataset
tools.description: Count how many clips and hours match a filter set for a dataset tier, with the fixed price. Free, reserves nothing, needs no buyer details. Use it to iterate on filters before quoting.

tools.name: search_vintage_footage
tools.description: Search Stockfilm's archive of authentic vintage home movie clips from the 1930s-1980s. Returns clips with metadata, pricing, thumbnails, and licensing info. All footage is real 8mm/Super 8 film — no AI-generated content.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_dataset_checkout, get_4k_order, get_clip_details, get_dataset_order, license_clip, quote_training_dataset · Private data: create_4k_checkout, get_4k_order, get_dataset_order, quote_training_dataset · Public sink: check_clip_rights, quote_4k_license, quote_training_dataset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_dataset_checkout, get_4k_order, get_clip_details, get_dataset_order, license_clip, quote_training_dataset · Private data: create_4k_checkout, get_4k_order, get_dataset_order, quote_training_dataset · Public sink: check_clip_rights, quote_4k_license, quote_training_dataset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
